paragraphs: scGen Human Primary-Use Consensus and Validation
This document records the primary-use consensus for the 50-paper blinded scGen human-validation sample. It does not replace the reviewers' complete six-field records.

Forty-four labels were identical after normalization of capitalization and wording. Four disagreements were resolved by user adjudication: SCGEN-HV-024 = Mention only; SCGEN-HV-029 = Benchmark; SCGEN-HV-043 = Mention only; SCGEN-HV-050 = Benchmark. Reviewer 2 left the primary-use field blank for SCGEN-HV-037 and SCGEN-HV-040, so the completed Reviewer 1 labels were carried forward and marked as such.
Mention only: 37; Benchmark: 9; Apply to biological data: 3; Other: 1; Extend or develop: 0. Total: 50.

Primary-use performance was evaluated on the 40 preselected CLASSIFICATION cases. The 10 PROCESS_AUDIT cases were excluded because they test citation-retrieval and coverage decisions rather than citation-use classification. Agent predictions were taken from the final primary_label field in 20260903_scgen_rescue_consolidated_v1 and compared with the human consensus labels. Exact agreement was 37/40 (92.5%).

Macro precision: 74.1%; macro recall: 68.8%. These are unweighted means of one-vs-rest category scores. A category-specific rate is not estimable when its denominator is zero; therefore the macro precision and macro recall each average the four estimable category rates. The three primary-use mismatches were SCGEN-HV-039 (agent Extend or develop; human Benchmark), SCGEN-HV-040 (agent Mention only; human Other), and SCGEN-HV-050 (agent Extend or develop; human Benchmark).
